---
title: "All slide decks"
subtitle: "Fifteen revealjs presentations, in teaching order"
---

Every deck opens as a full-screen presentation. Useful keys inside a deck:
`?` shows all shortcuts, `o` opens the slide overview, `f` goes full screen, and
`e` switches to print view so you can save the deck as a PDF from your browser.

The **Source** link opens the `.qmd` behind each deck — the R code that produced
every figure and table is in there.
